dataset_example.question:
You are The Scientist. A hidden deterministic universe maps integer inputs x1 and x2 to y.

This is Level 1: the law is an affine law using 1, x1, and x2. Coefficients are small integers. Inputs must be integers in [-3, 3]. You have at most 6 laboratory experiments.

Use the experiment tool to choose informative measurements.

When ready, stop experimenting and reply with only one JSON object:
{"f
